Watch the provided video to learn about three specific acquisitions from that year. Next, for each acquisition, calculate the ratio of the acquisition price to the age of the MCN at the time of acquisition (in years). Sum these three ratios to get a value R.

Then, determine the founding years of the acquiring companies for the first and third acquisitions from external sources, and compute the absolute difference between these founding years to get D.

Additionally, note the day number mentioned in the video's sponsorship segment.

Finally, compute R × D × the sponsorship day number and provide the final integer result.
